MODGEE estimation from species detection histories

Source: R/modgee-package.R
modgee-package.Rd

Fit the original MODGEE model to estimate detection parameters, cumulative extinction and dark extinctions.

Details

Use fit_modgee to fit a prepared species-by-interval binary matrix. Use example_M for a documented development example.

Time aggregation and baseline selection are performed before fitting. Grouped models share a temporal extinction baseline and may compare fixed-k and free-k models. Bootstrap confidence intervals are not computed by these functions.

See also

Functions: read_matrix, fit_modgee, plot_modgee

Examples: example_file, example_M, example_groups, example_result, example_grouped_result
